stage1.selection: row-major normal-soil candidates last third random

stage3.selection: row-major normal-soil candidates last third random

progression.stage1: Enter BossRoom tile marker92 with item82 key (consumed), defeat SubBoss1000HP -> next stage sequence -> stage2
progression.stage2: Collect special mineral item11 at (15,389) -> next stage sequence -> stage3. Rescue Member sidequest once for100000
progression.stage3: Enter BossRoom with item82 key (consumed), defeat Boss3000HP -> ending; all3 special minerals produces happy ending
progression.note: Stage1 special mineral is optional to progress, required for good ending. No fabricated depth-only advancement.

digPatternSemantics.match: iterate all patterns; last match wins; update dug neighbors after current tile

movement.jumpRule: on up: if airborne then vy < -boost ? vy=-boost : vy-=1+boost/20; otherwise airborne=true,vy=-3. Then gravity adds1 each core tick.

digging.rule: on beginning bDig=true,landLife=2; subsequently countDig++ >= landLife-digSpeed triggers one dig step and resets count; landLife determined by absolute target row. First step sets73/spawns mineral, then74..78, then clears prop1 to20. Rock tile16 ignores ordinary digging. Cannot dig upward.

oxygen.normal: if displayed depth<5:0; otherwise effectiveDepth=depth+(stage3?100:0); digging:base*(effectiveDepth/30)^1.1; walking:base*(effectiveDepth/100)^0.8

damage.bossIdentityWarning: Player.damage uses obj==Boss.inst, but Boss.action passes coll_mc, so 40 branch may not be reached in original; choose deliberate fix rather than claim exact

combat.explosionHits: at most one non-player/non-bomb object, player immune to own bomb
combat.dynamite: only standing over tile16, not sky/boss/bottom6rows; clears exactly target tile, adds5000score

fuses.source: Sprite381/375 first PlaceObject372 frame49; Sprite373 first PlaceObject372 frame42. Static timeline confirmed by asset extraction task.

ItemDragon.whenNoKey: intended guaranteed item82 key; original [-1,100] cumulative probability causes 1% no reward bug
